maya: Starting a new thread — small repro for the Next.js sample playbook + LangChain/LlamaIndex starter. Edge SSR, using redwood-js SDK (v0.9.2) and python eval harness. Hitting intermittent 401s after a 429. Anyone seen auth token rotation weirdness? :eyes:

liam: @maya can you paste the server logs and the client snippet? Is this happening on Hosted or Dedicated?

maya: Hosted (eu-west). Logs:
```
2026-03-20T14:12:03Z ERROR fetch /v1/generate 429 Too Many Requests
2026-03-20T14:12:03Z INFO retrying request (attempt 2)
2026-03-20T14:12:03Z ERROR fetch /v1/generate 401 Unauthorized
```
Client snippet (Next edge api route):
```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_RW_KEY });
await client.generate(prompt, { maxTokens: 256 });
```
Note we were passing NEXT_PUBLIC_ key into edge runtime.

omar: yup that's the issue — using NEXT_PUBLIC_ exposes the key to the browser and some edge setups rotate short-lived creds; also the browser-surface key gets rate-limited differently. Switch to server-only secret and use cookies or server action to call the SDK.

gina: Also check SDK parity — JS SDK v0.9.2 had a retry backoff bug where 429->401 could be misclassified and not refresh creds. We patched in v0.9.4. Try upgrading.

maya: upgrading to 0.9.4 + moving to server secret fixed it in my quick smoke test. Still want a small doc note in the Next starter about "Edge SSR + auth" and an example of server action pattern.

liam: Agreed. I'll add a short blurb to the starter README and an automated smoke test in the eval harness. ping me if you can add the exact repro steps.

maya: Will open a tiny PR with repro branch and CLI commands to run eval locally. Thanks :thumbsup:

devx-bot: CI run queued for PR #4281 — redwood/starter-next-playbook — smoke tests pending.

liam: @maya @gina can you coordinate the README and changelog entry? I'll schedule the eval harness test.

maya: On it, thanks everyone.
